clue.text: Hacker said to be safe

indicators.note: said tells us to go by how the word for a hacker sounds when spoken

parts.note: a hacker is someone with a rasping cough, a cougher

explanation.surface: Someone claims a computer hacker poses no risk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hacker' looks like a computer intruder, but here it is a person with a hacking cough.
explanation.definitionFit: A strongbox where money or valuables are locked away is a safe.

clue.text: Expedition finds it in a plant

indicators.note: in places the word it inside the name of the plant

parts.note: celery is a vegetable plant
taken as written

explanation.surface: An explorer's trip turns up something inside a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Expedition' looks like a journey, but it is used in its older sense of promptness.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition in the sense of speed and dispatch is a synonym of swiftness.

clue.text: Perfume for kid in the country

indicators.note: in puts the word for kid inside the country's name

parts.note: France is the country
to kid is to tease, to rag

explanation.surface: Buying scent for a child somewhere abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kid' looks like a child, but it is the verb meaning to tease.
explanation.definitionFit: Perfume and scent both mean a pleasant smell.

clue.text: It's bad to be climbing

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means the word reads upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: to be, to exist, is to live

explanation.surface: Someone declares that climbing is wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicked and bad are synonyms for something morally wrong.

clue.text: Cod pie is off — it appears occasionally

definitions.note: a clause describing something; the answer is the adjective for such a thing

indicators.note: off, as in gone bad or not right, tells us these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A fish pie has gone bad, a dish that turns up now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is off' reads as the pie going bad; 'is' joins the fodder and 'off' alone signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something occurring in separate instances, now and then, is described this way, like a serial.

clue.text: It's elementary to put forward Reagan

parts.note: to posit is to put forward an idea
Ronald Reagan, US president, shortened to Ron

explanation.surface: A remark that proposing Reagan is the obvious choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's elementary' sounds like 'it's simple', but it means an elementary particle.
explanation.definitionFit: A subatomic particle, the antiparticle of the electron, is one of the elementary particles of physics.

clue.text: Rakes appearing in a queue for lace

indicators.note: appearing in puts the garden tools inside the word for a queue

parts.note: a string is a line or queue of things
rakes and hoes are both garden tools

explanation.surface: Dissolute men stand in line to buy lace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rakes' looks like libertines, but it stands for garden tools; a queue is a string as in a string of people.
explanation.definitionFit: A bootlace is a cord threaded through the eyelets of footwear.

clue.text: Song (amateur work) about doublet

indicators.note: about means the amateur work goes around the other piece

parts.note: DIY, do-it-yourself, is amateur work round the home
doublet read as double T, two letter Ts

explanation.surface: An amateur song about a man's close-fitting jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doublet' looks like the Elizabethan jacket, but splits into 'double T'.
explanation.definitionFit: A short simple tune with words is a song.

clue.text: Scream when grabbing girl's fruit

indicators.note: grabbing means the scream holds the girl's word inside it

parts.note: to scream is to cry
a girl's things are her things

explanation.surface: Someone shrieks while snatching a girl's piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round stone fruit, red when ripe, is an example of a fruit.

clue.text: Greek enters a flat that's lit up

indicators.note: enters puts the Greek abbreviation inside the other pieces

parts.note: flat land is low-lying
G is a standard abbreviation for Greek

explanation.surface: A Greek moves into an apartment that is brightly lit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' looks like an apartment, but it means low-lying.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowing with light, shining, is the same as lit up.

clue.text: Idleness of dolt lying in the heather

indicators.note: lying in places the fool inside the plant's name

parts.note: ling is a common name for heather
a dolt is an oaf

explanation.surface: A lazy fool sprawls among the moorland heather.
explanation.definitionFit: Lazing about doing nothing is idleness.

clue.text: Tax relationship with dog

parts.note: scot is an old word for a tax, as in scot-free
a tie is a bond or relationship

explanation.surface: A tax bond tied up with a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: SCOT survives in 'scot-free', meaning without paying.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish terrier is a breed of dog.

clue.text: Girl rings right choice

indicators.note: rings means the girl's name goes around the letter for right

parts.note: Rae is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl phones and makes the correct decision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rings' looks like phoning, but it means encircles; 'choice' is an adjective meaning fine.
explanation.definitionFit: Choice, as in choice cuts, means excellent and uncommonly good, like something seldom found.

clue.text: Sibyl tossed toys ashore

indicators.note: tossed means thrown about, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A prophetess threw some toys onto the beach.
explanation.definitionFit: A sibyl was a prophetess of the ancient world, a foreteller of the future.

clue.text: Plan to go in goal, reportedly

parts.note: to enter is to go in

indicators.note: reportedly means we take the sound of the word for goal

parts.note: a goal is a prize one aims for

explanation.surface: A footballer's scheme to head into the net, so they say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goal' looks like football, but it means a prize, which sounds like PRISE.
explanation.definitionFit: A venture or undertaking is a project or plan.

clue.text: A shelter without an occupant

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the shelter goes around the other piece

parts.note: a tent is a shelter
taken as written

explanation.surface: A shelter left with nobody living in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but it means outside, wrapped around AN.
explanation.definitionFit: One who rents and occupies a property is its occupant.

clue.text: Composer grasps our bottle

indicators.note: grasps means the composer holds the other word inside

parts.note: John Cage was an American composer
taken as written

explanation.surface: A composer clutches our wine bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottle' looks like a container, but in British slang it means nerve or courage.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang, bottle means nerve or bravery.

clue.text: Winger died in game on island

indicators.note: in puts the abbreviation for died inside the game

parts.note: golf is a game
inch is a Scottish word for a small island

explanation.surface: A winger dies during a game on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' looks like a footballer, but it is a bird; INCH is Scots for an island, as in Inchcolm.
explanation.definitionFit: A brightly coloured finch is a bird, a creature with wings.

clue.text: Oriental soldier supports niggard in sacred song

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting pieces sit below the niggard

parts.note: a niggard is a miser
E for eastern, oriental
RE, Royal Engineers, are soldiers

explanation.surface: An eastern soldier backs a stingy man in a hymn.
explanation.definitionFit: Psalm 51, 'have mercy', set to music is a sacred song.

clue.text: Spread top-class preserve for islander

parts.note: jam is a spread for bread
A1 means top-class, written as AI
to can food is to preserve it

explanation.surface: A top-quality jam spread for someone from an island.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 means first-rate; the numeral 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the Caribbean island nation is a native islander.

clue.text: Plot that's malicious creates trouble

parts.note: a plot of garden is a bed
evil means malicious

explanation.surface: A wicked conspiracy causes problems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' looks like a scheme, but it is a garden bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To plague or harass is to trouble someone.

clue.text: Organised gala in Roman England

indicators.note: organised means arranged in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A festive gala laid on in Roman England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin name for the land of the Angles, England.

clue.text: King found in a bogus religious retreat

indicators.note: found in places the king's letter inside the other pieces

parts.note: something bogus is a sham
R, for Rex, is king

explanation.surface: A king discovered in a fake holy refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu hermitage or community for spiritual retreat.

clue.text: Experience a small scotch

parts.note: to scotch is to put an end to, to kill

explanation.surface: Having experience of a small whisky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scotch' looks like whisky, but it is the verb meaning to stamp out.
explanation.definitionFit: Experience in the sense of expertise or practised ability.

clue.text: Dog for lively king in Kent

indicators.note: in puts the lively king inside the abbreviation for Kent's region

parts.note: Kent is a county in the south-east of England, SE
chipper means lively and cheerful
K is the abbreviation for king in chess

explanation.surface: A dog for a cheerful king living in Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent, a county in south-east England, gives SE.
explanation.definitionFit: A small black Belgian breed of dog.

clue.text: The fellow's keeping father up a great deal

indicators.note: keeping means the fellow's word holds the other inside

parts.note: the fellow's is a contraction of he is

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word reads upward, backwards

parts.note: pa is father

explanation.surface: A man keeps raising his father enormously.
explanation.definitionFit: Heaps, as in heaps of money, means lots, a large amount.

clue.text: Present suggested for old king

indicators.note: suggested signals a sound-alike: the word is suggested by its sound

parts.note: to present is to offer

explanation.surface: A gift proposed for an ancient monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: Offa was an 8th-century king of Mercia, famed for Offa's Dyke.
explanation.definitionFit: The Anglo-Saxon ruler of Mercia was a monarch of long ago.

clue.text: Mark creates endless panic

indicators.note: endless means the word for panic loses its final letter

parts.note: a scare is a panic

explanation.surface: A stain causes unending alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: A blemish left by a healed wound is a mark.

clue.text: Become aware that lies are risky

indicators.note: risky, like something unsafe, signals the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Coming to understand that lying is dangerous.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp or understand something is to become aware of it.

clue.text: Abrupt amateur keeps cheating

indicators.note: keeps means the amateur holds the cheating word inside

parts.note: laic means lay, non-professional
a con is a cheat or swindle

explanation.surface: A curt amateur keeps on cheating.
explanation.definitionFit: Using very few words, terse, is brusque or abrupt.

clue.text: Many approve holding note for composer

parts.note: M is a thousand in Roman numerals, so many

indicators.note: holding means the approval word goes around the note

parts.note: to assent is to approve
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Many agree to keep a note for a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Jules Massenet was a French composer of operas such as Manon.

clue.text: Deprived child in pub in African port

indicators.note: in places the pub abbreviation inside the port

parts.note: Oran is a port in Algeria
PH, public house, is a pub

explanation.surface: A poor child found in a bar in an African port.
explanation.definitionFit: A child who has lost both parents is deprived of them.
